title: Sinoma commissions Loesche for Qassim Cement grinding plant
summary: Sinoma commissions Loesche for Qassim Cement grinding plant
body_markdown:
**Saudi Arabia:** Loesche announced on 13 November 2026 that it has been commissioned by Sinoma International Engineering with the delivery of a 300t/hr ordinary Portland cement (OPC) grinding plant for Qassim Cement’s facility in Buraydah. The grinding plant to be supplied now includes a Loesche vertical roller mill identical in design to one previously supplied to the plant, allowing the interchangeability of key components.


Delivery of the new grinding plant will take place by the end of 2026, with commissioning scheduled to begin in early 2027.
